title: Direct-agent proof: containerd vLLM lifecycle
description: Implement pull/start/stop/delete for one supervised vLLM workload through containerd on a GPU node, including selected NVIDIA runtime/CDI GPU exposure and cleanup behavior.

logs.msg: Research validated: containerd Go client v2 provides clean pull→NewContainer→NewTask→Start lifecycle. CDI devices injected into OCI spec at container creation. vLLM official image vllm/vllm-openai with --ipc=host for PyTorch shared memory. Model weights via volume mount + HF_TOKEN env.
